method_notes: Useful sources: Transportstyrelsen (Sweden) compilation of IMO COLREG.2 circulars (467 pages, scanned OCR, covers Circ.4 to about Circ.69) gave adoption and implementation data for most records; CIMRC (Shanghai Maritime University) hosts clean IMO circular copies; IMO wwwcdn Assembly resolutions (A.374(X), A.827(19)). Access problems: resmigazete.gov.tr and mevzuat.gov.tr timed out or returned empty replies, so the official Turkish 2019 regulation was not read; English text only via an unofficial host (lead only). WebFetch cannot parse many PDFs; downloading and extracting with pypdf worked. COLREG.2/Circ.78 (Odesa successor scheme) not retrieved from IMO. No primary Egyptian (Port Said, Damietta, Gulf of Suez) or South African VTS sources found in budget. Suggested method changes: treat superseded Odessa records as one successor record; for Crimea/Kerch use neutral 'Not established' status and attribute statements to their source; seek the current IMO Ships' Routeing edition to confirm in-force status in one step.
